scope: Resolve prepared, loaded analytical, and free-MEA concentration definitions without changing absorber kinetics or thermodynamics.

prepared_unloaded_concentration.basis: mass fraction of MEA in the unloaded MEA-water solution and solution density at the stated conversion temperature

loaded_analytical_concentration.basis: one litre of the loaded liquid volume; analytical MEA moles are conserved across speciation

free_mea_concentration.basis: true molecular MEA species only; it is not a replacement for prepared or analytical concentration
source_locators: Putta2016: printed p. 347, Figures 6 and 7 captions

loading.equation: alpha = (n_CO2 + n_MEACOO- + n_HCO3- + n_CO3^2-) / (n_MEA + n_MEAH+ + n_MEACOO-)
loading.units: mol CO2 per mol analytical MEA
loading.basis: nine-species balance on the loaded liquid volume

solution_volume.prepared: V_prepared is the volume of unloaded solution used to establish the mass-basis preparation concentration.
solution_volume.loaded: V_loaded is the loaded liquid solution volume used by analytical and free-species concentrations.
solution_volume.reason: The retained Putta/Luo and NCCC Case 3C records do not provide paired gravimetric sample masses or a reported prepared-to-loaded volume ratio.

locators: printed p. 340, Table 1: literature rows labelled MEA = 1 kmol/m3 and 5 kmol/m3
printed p. 340, Section 2: procedures are already published and are not repeated
printed pp. 347--348, Figures 6 and 7 captions: molarity of MEA solution and free MEA concentration are separate quantities
resolved_claims: The concentration-model literature labels include 1 M and 5 M ranges.
Free MEA is a separate model quantity from molarity of the MEA solution.
unresolved_claims: Putta does not establish the preparation temperature, local loaded analytical concentration, or solution-volume convention for the inherited literature rows.
Putta does not provide a row-specific concentration uncertainty that admits an exact discrete 1 M or 5 M absorber input.

locators: printed p. 59, Section 3.1: 1 M and 5 M aqueous MEA labels, loading 0--0.4, temperature 298--343 K
printed p. 61, Section 3.2: aqueous MEA solutions were prepared on a mass basis and MEA was dissolved in deionized water
printed p. 61, Section 3.2, Equations 15 and 16: 1 M and 5 M density correlations; relative total standard deviation 0.06% and 0.17%, respectively
resolved_claims: Preparation is mass-basis, not a stated fixed-volume preparation.
The 1 M and 5 M labels are prepared-solution labels used for the kinetic experiments.
unresolved_claims: No preparation temperature or paired prepared/loaded solution volume is reported in the retained article locations.
The balance accuracy of +/- 1e-5 kg is not enough to reconstruct a row-specific final concentration uncertainty without the actual preparation masses.

locators: printed p. 10467, Table 1: NCCC steady-state rows and nominal lean-solvent MEA weight fraction
printed p. 10468, Section 2.2, Equations 1 and 2: nominal MEA is the no-CO2 mass-basis amount and loading is CO2/MEA
printed p. 10469--10470, Section 2.4 and Table 4: steady-state campaign expanded uncertainty estimates
resolved_claims: NCCC nominal MEA composition is a no-CO2, mass-basis solvent amount.
Campaign-level nominal amine composition uncertainty is 7.3% expanded uncertainty at approximately 95% confidence (k = 2).
Campaign-level process amine concentration uncertainty is 6.0% and process CO2 loading uncertainty is 10.7% expanded uncertainty.

reported_uncertainties.applicability: NCCC steady-state campaign-level estimate; not a Case 3C-specific paired sample remeasurement

locators: printed p. 3096, Experimental Section: unloaded solutions were made with deionized water; loaded solutions were prepared by bubbling CO2
printed p. 3096, Experimental Section: density uncertainty +/- 0.00005 g/cm3 and temperature uncertainty +/- 0.03 K
printed p. 3097, Tables 1 and 3: 30 wt% MEA unloaded and loaded density observations
printed p. 3099: combined density uncertainty +/- 0.05% for unloaded and +/- 0.2% for loaded systems, except highest temperatures/loadings
resolved_claims: Density observations provide an independent mass-fraction-to-molarity conversion for 30 wt% MEA.
The loaded density source is distinct from the retained ePC-SAFT profile density and does not redefine a literature concentration label.

nccc_case.nominal_mea_mass_fraction_source: Morgan2018 Table 1 / retained NCCC 2017 input row
nccc_case.lean_solvent_temperature_status: 45 C imputation in run-ready input; not a preparation temperature

density_observations.composition: 30 wt% MEA in water, loaded with CO2
density_observations.interpolation: bilinear in temperature and loading using only the tabulated bracketing observations; no extrapolation

retained_profile.full_species_reconstruction: The retained profile stores the five neutral/primary species columns; the nine-species concentration vector is reconstructed by the retained tabulated reactive-equilibrium call from Fl_CO2, Fl_MEA, Fl_H2O, Tl, and rho_mol_l.
retained_profile.volume_basis: mol/m3 concentrations in the retained loaded liquid state; converted to mol/L by division by 1000
